builtAt: 2026-08-14 Save live Airbnb browser session for Pull

patches.note: Tell the user Pull reuses the live in-app browser
patches.find:
'
This browser is running on the server. When Hosting opens, Connect saves its session automatically for Pull.
' +
patches.replace:
'
This browser is running on the server. After the code screen, click Save session for Pull — or Pull Airbnb, which reuses this live browser.
' +

patches.note: Add Save session for Pull on the live browser
patches.replace:
'<button class="btn sm" onclick="piAirbnbBrowserRefresh()">Refresh screen</button>' +
        '<button class="btn gold sm" onclick="piAirbnbBrowserSave()">Save session for Pull</button>' +
        '<button class="btn sm" onclick="piCancelAirbnbConnect()">Cancel</button>' +

patches.note: Wire Save session to the live-browser save route
